methodology.contest: agent-browser means the CLI driving Headless Shell. Lightpanda is scored on the CLI path an agent uses, with direct CDP reported separately.
methodology.cold: New browser process and, for the CLI, a unique daemon and session. Timer stops after local navigation plus interactive snapshot (CLI) or JS ready (direct).
methodology.warm: Median of five extra interactive snapshots on the same process. Direct engines read the accessibility tree over CDP when the domain exists.
methodology.memory: Sum of VmRSS and, when readable, proportional set size of processes that appeared during the trial, sampled 80ms after ready and before the action.
methodology.agentUse: CLI trials use snapshot refs, fill, click, and get text. Direct trials set the field and click through the DOM, which is not the agent hit-test path.
methodology.screenshot: PNG must contain the fixture navy background, a red canvas border, and a black canvas fill.
methodology.diskCache: uncontrolled; the shell binary was smoke-launched once before this run

decision.rule: Usability (ref click plus screenshot fidelity, every trial) gates the win. If both pass, more category wins takes it. Direct CDP numbers are context, not the agent interface.
